text: Stepping through this sleek, modern hallway and into the exhibition space, I am enveloped in a mood of curiosity and anticipation. The luminous blues and oranges, the displays of text and screens, all evoke a sense of innovation and intellectual pursuit. It feels as though I am on the threshold of discovery, surrounded by both the artifacts of human thought and the suggestions of future possibilities. There’s an invitation here to reflect on how research shapes us—as individuals and as a collective species. I feel quietly excited, aware of the larger questions that linger behind these vibrant displays.
